title: Hawaiian Roll BBQ Chicken Pizza Sliders
description: A unique and delicious twist on barbecue chicken pizza using King's Hawaiian rolls as the base.
steps: Brush a layer of barbecue sauce onto the Hawaiian rolls.
Add a layer of shredded mozzarella cheese.
Mix the shredded chicken with some barbecue sauce, then spread it evenly over the cheese layer.
Add optional toppings like red onions and bacon crumbles.
Top with a sprinkle of Gouda cheese.
Bake in the oven at 350 degrees until the edges are toasty and the cheese is melted.
Remove from the oven, cut, and serve.
notes:
The author notes that while the concept of using Hawaiian rolls for pizza seemed weird, the final result is delicious.
